defective_pattern: Locally fixing a deliverable after user error feedback without triggering the native multi-agent learning pipeline.
why_defective: Local silent patching leaves the underlying failure mechanism undocumented in the knowledge store, guaranteeing that future subagents and subsequent micro-stages will repeat the exact same defect.
observed_symptoms: Orchestrator immediately modifying files or re-running scripts upon user critique without diagnosing root causes
Same formatting or statistical error recurring across multiple chapters
Absence of persistent lesson JSON in learning/knowledge/lessons/ after negative feedback
corrective_remedy: Upon receiving any user critique or defect report, emit a USER_FEEDBACK_DETECTED event and invoke the learning pipeline (trajectory-analyzer for chronology, behavior-analyst for root cause, knowledge-curator for persistent anti-pattern/lesson).

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: USER_FEEDBACK containing negative critique or defect indicators (wrong, error, missing, incorrect, not right) MUST trigger invoke_subagent(TypeName='knowledge-curator').
